rows.en: ...He'll show up again sooner or later. To take back his Core Medals.
It wasn't many, but I snatched some of his Cores.
I told you, didn't I? My goal is the Core Medals, plain and simple.
But right now, getting back to my own world comes first... That's all!
Core Medals. Collecting them is my goal.
But right now, getting back to my own world comes first...
Heroes, we commend you on your first-round victory.
The next match venue is on Floor 3.
The semifinal venue on Floor 3 is still being prepared. Wait a little longer.
The Masurao VS Zamsha match was already underway.
I desire nothing but pure battle! Battle with a Gundam!
My name is Zamsha. I am no Gundam.
That I know full well! And yet, why...
However...!! That great weapon of yours will never strike me!
Why is it that you fight!?
To prove that my strength is the greatest in the universe!
Splendid!! What I seek is the summit that only those who do battle may reach!
I have honed my mind's eye!!
...Masurao. To think anyone but the heroes could be so skilled!
...Zamsha. To think anything but a Gundam could so captivate my heart!
...Oh! Gundam!! To think we would meet again!!
I hear that you defeated the Over Flags. How bitter their regret must be...
It is I, Masurao, who shall carry on their will.
...But now I know that I lack the strength to defeat the Gundam.
It galls me, but I shall return to my training! Until we meet again!!
...You are the Gundam's comrades!! To think we would meet again!!
I hear that you defeated the Over Flags. How bitter their regret must be...
It is I, Masurao, who shall carry on their will.
...But now I know that I lack the strength to defeat the Gundam.
It galls me, but I am only human. I shall return to my training! Until we meet again!!
So here you are. I've been looking for you.
The semifinal venue is ready. Proceed to the venue on Floor 3.
The Walter Gundam VS Pandon match was already underway.
Walter Gundam is down. Pandon seems to have the upper hand.
Is that all you've got? Pandon...
Walter Gundam's battered body is repairing itself before their very eyes!
A monster that once gave Ultraseven a hard time? Don't make me laugh!!

notes.note: 0449.bla never calls rows #0.31-0.51 (after the battle it goes #0.30 Uva -> #0.53-0.55 Masquerade), so this is likely an unused post-battle exchange. Speakers unlabelled; inferred: #0.31/#0.32 Ankh (he took some of Uva's Cores, Uva will come back for them), #0.33-0.45 party-leader reactions, #0.46-0.51 Ankh except #0.49.

13-slot leader-variant block, no Pt_Chara_Check order available (unused text). Identical lines kept identical; #0.37 is the polite 'Ankh-san' variant (likely Mebius), rendered 'Ankh...' without the rough 'you'.
'moto no sekai' from Ankh's mouth = his own world; 'my own world' chosen over 'our'.
Unlabelled 'Core?': someone unfamiliar with Core Medals (non-OOO party member) asking; Ankh answers in #0.50.
'Hero shokun' rendered 'Heroes'; 'we commend' = the organisers (Masquerade speaking for Regis).
Narration; 'had begun' read as the heroes arriving mid-match, so 'was already underway'. Same for 0454 #0.1.
'Dekiru!' = Zamsha's aside about Masurao's skill; 'He is skilled!' keeps his formal register.
Mr. Bushido's 'Kirisute gomen' cry stretched across two lines; rendered 'Cut you dooown!!! Pardon meeeee!!!' to keep the samurai formula and the elongation.
#0.23-0.35 are a 13-slot leader-variant block (only #0.23 labelled, Black RX). All identical Japanese, so all '...Masurao.'

#0.37-0.41 = 00-in-party branch (addressing the Gundam); #0.44-0.48 = branch addressing the Gundam's comrades. Identical Japanese gets identical English. 'Over Flags' = the Overflag squad, as in earlier slices. 'the Gundam' = 00, Mr. Bushido's rival.
'Watashi tote hito no ko da' = 'I am only human' (admitting his frustration), kept in full.
Masquerade finds the party; Ankh answers in #0.50, so this is the Ankh-led variant.
Pandon cry 'Kiiiiiih!!'; no earlier English for Pandon's roar found. #0.6 short 'Kih!?' follows it.
Walter Gundam (g=n) sneering at Pandon, an Ultraseven monster; 'warawasete kureru' = 'Don't make me laugh!!'

report: 80/80 rows. 0449 #0.31-0.51 are not called by 0449.bla (likely unused); speakers inferred (Ankh / party leaders). Leader-variant blocks 0449 #0.33-0.45 and 0452 #0.23-0.35 kept identical. New: Pandon cry 'Kiiiiiih!!', Mr. Bushido 'Cut you dooown!!! Pardon meeeee!!!'. No new names.
